## Hardware VP9 trailer playback

- Prefer VP9 over AVC/H.264 at the same resolution only when a hardware decoder advertises support for the rendition's dimensions, frame rate and profile. Resolution remains the primary ordering key.
- Exclude VP9 renditions without verified hardware capability. Unknown dimensions or failed capability queries fall back conservatively to the existing formats.
- Keep AVC/H.264 alternatives for CDN and decoder failures. Do not attempt software VP9 in the trailer renderer; decoder failures advance past VP9 candidates. Preserve position when switching renditions after a playback error.
- Apply the selection to inline and fullscreen trailers without recreating the player during expansion. Include VP9 eligibility and hardware decoder names in opt-in diagnostics.
- Retain yt-dlp removal and the preceding diagnostic/navigation improvements.

Signed 32-bit build. Physical-TV comparison of Unabomber's VP9 and AVC renditions is still required; a visible quality improvement is not guaranteed.
